value.rationale: The question is motivated by magnetization plateaux and frustration on line-graph lattices. It establishes graph-independent exact microcanonical and field behavior for all sparse biregular base geometries, a uniform result not obtainable merely by studying one complete bipartite graph. Yet critical saturation entropy varies between nonisomorphic connected cubic graphs with identical field response (1104 versus 1092), revealing a physical separation of universality and combinatorial entropy. Explicit field thresholds and degeneracies provide benchmark calculations.
